B0BG329SH3.title: 2-1 Smart Switch (On/Off or Dimmer) - Blue Series
bullets: DIMMER OR ON/OFF - One switch no matter the application. Use as a dimmer switch or a momenatry on/off switch.
NO NEUTRAL REQUIRED - If you don't have a neutral wire you can still install and us the 2-1, although neutral wire installations provide the most functionality.
ONE WAY, 3-WAY, MORE WAYS - The 2-1 can be installed as a single location, 3-way, or multi-way setup.
USE EXISTING OR ADD AUX SWITCH - In 3 way and multi-way setups, you can use existing dumb switches, or add the Inovelli Aux Switch for maximum control and dimming from all switch locations.
CUSTOMIZABLE LED - The most advanced switch on the market offers the most advanced features, including customizable LED.
NOTE: Faceplate not included and shown for illustrative purposes only.

B08428GDS8.title: Enbrighten Zigbee In-Wall Smart Dimmer, Paddle, White or Light Almond
bullets: EASY VOICE CONTROL – Pair directly with Echo Studio, Echo Show 10, or 1st and 2nd generation Echo Plus immediately out of the package for easy voice command of connected devices. No additional equipment is required for use with these Echo models. Other Alexa and Google Assistant products can also be used for voice control when connected through a compatible Zigbee hub.

CONVENIENT DESIGN – Improved components reduced the housing depth by up to 20 percent compared to previous Zigbee models and eliminated the need for heat tabs. QuickFit enhancements are the ideal smart solution for older-style switch boxes, multi-gang configurations or any other application with limited space.

RAPID INSTALLATION WITH SIMPLEWIRE – Auto-detecting line/load terminals support fast and easy installation by identifying line and load wires and configuring the dimmer accordingly. Dual ground ports, which are offset to avoid switch box mounting screws, support daisy-chaining in multi-gang setups.

VERSATILE USE – Requires in-wall installation with hardwired connections – neutral wire REQUIRED. Supports 3-way and other multi-switch configurations when paired with up to four add-on switches – model 46199. Includes white and light almond paddles (wallplate not included). Works with dimmable LEDs and CFLs as well as incandescent, and halogen bulbs.

TRUSTED NETWORK – Zigbee 3. 0 is forward and backward compatible and does not use well-known network keys, which allows reliable, safe home automation. Certified device-to-device interoperability and a proven mesh network eliminate single points of failure while supporting large networks. The smart dimmer also extends your Zigbee signal by up to 150ft.

B0F2N68K3C.title: Aqara Smart Dimmer Switch H2, 2-in-1 Neutral, Thread/Zigbee Protocol
bullets: Thread/Zigbee Protocol: Aqara smart dimmer switch H2 supports matter-over-thread and zigbee, ensuring compatibility with major third-party platforms such as Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant. In Zigbee mode, users can access the full range of Aqara Home features, including dimming range,indicator light setting,On/Off transition settings,brightness adjustment increment(Zigbee2MQTT and comparable third-party USB dongles are not officially supported by Aqara. Full product functionality may be limited or unavailable）

2-in-1 Neutral for Hassle-Free Installation: The led dimmer switch supports both no-neutral and with-neutral wiring setups, eliminating any concerns about your home's wiring configuration. For homes without a neutral wire, installation is straight forward, while for homes with neutral wiring, overload protection is enabled, while additional advanced features such as power monitoring

Silent On/Off and Dimming: All three buttons operate silently for a quieter environment. The top button turns the light on/off, while the other two adjust brightness. Enjoy smooth dimming from soft ambient light to full brightness. By default, lights toggle in 0.5 seconds, and each dimmer press changes brightness by 10%, and users can also customize this percentage in the Aqara Home app

Extensive Light Compatibility: The dimmer switch offers wide light compatibility, supporting incandescent, halogen, dimmable CFL/LED, and ELV types of non-smart lamps. Compatible with both forward and reverse phase dimming can easily match existing lamps, bring a stable dimming experience, ready for future lighting upgrades

Custom Brightness Limits: Set your preferred maximum and minimum brightness levels to prevent flickering or power loss. Maximum Brightness ensures smooth performance for low-power lights, while Minimum Brightness prevents flickering or failure at low levels. Once configured, the lights cannot be brightened above or dimmed below that setting
